PHYSICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Heat Transmission ● Heat. ● Modes of heat transmission . ● Applications of heat ? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Heat Transmission ● Heat. ● Modes of heat transmission . ● Applications of heat .
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Heat Transmission ● Heat. ● Modes of heat transmission . ● Applications of heat .
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Heat Transmission ● Heat. ● Modes of heat transmission . ● Applications of heat .
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Heat Transmission ● Heat. ● Modes of heat transmission . ● Applications of heat .

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dimensional analysis ● Confirming the correctness of formulae and units involvin? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dimensional analysis ● Confirming the correctness of formulae and units involvin.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Dimensional analysis ● Confirming the correctness of formulae and units involvin.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dimensional analysis ● Confirming the correctness of formulae and units involvin.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dimensional analysis ● Confirming the correctness of formulae and units involvin.

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fluid Flow ● Types of fluid flow (steady flow, unsteady flow, laminar flow, turb? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fluid Flow ● Types of fluid flow (steady flow, unsteady flow, laminar flow, turb.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fluid Flow ● Types of fluid flow (steady flow, unsteady flow, laminar flow, turb.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fluid Flow ● Types of fluid flow (steady flow, unsteady flow, laminar flow, turb.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fluid Flow ● Types of fluid flow (steady flow, unsteady flow, laminar flow, turb.

8. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

9. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

10. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electromagnetic waves ● Production, properties, detection and applications of el? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electromagnetic waves ● Production, properties, detection and applications of el.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Electromagnetic waves ● Production, properties, detection and applications of el.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electromagnetic waves ● Production, properties, detection and applications of el.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electromagnetic waves ● Production, properties, detection and applications of el.

12. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Heat Transmission ● Heat. ● Modes of heat transmission . ● Applications of heat  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Electromagnetic waves ● Production, properties, detection and applications of el and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Thermionic emission and its applications ● Production of cathode rays and their  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
